_notes.code: Mission step string: one letter per step; +1/+2 switch joint-launch part; ! marks end; | terminates. Letter semantics are in constants.json (step_letters).
_notes.alt: Per-step alternate/abort step index: -1 none, -2 continue, -3 end (36 slots).
_notes.days: Duration level required: 0 none, 1-6 = A-F (confirm in constants.json).
_notes.crew_mode: 0 unmanned, 1 unmanned with capsule/minishuttle, 2 single-pad manned, 3 joint with one manned launch, 4 joint with two manned launches, 5 joint with unmanned capsule (upstream mCrew).
_notes.prestige_categories: Indices into prestige.json rows that this mission can claim.
_notes.downgrades: Ordered mission indices this mission falls back to when hardware is missing; 0 = none.
